report.summary: Patient P-D002 is a 46-year-old with Medicaid coverage that includes a transportation benefit, so she is eligible for non-emergency medical transportation through her Medicaid managed-care plan. She is not eligible for the senior shuttle (age 60+). ADA paratransit is an option but certification can take up to 21 days, and a local medical ride service serves the west side on Tuesdays/Thursdays.

options.name: Medicaid Ride Line (fictional)
options.how_to_access: Call the Medicaid member-services number on the Lakeshore Community Health Plan card at least 2 business days before the appointment to schedule a covered ride.

options.name: RideWell Medical Transport
options.how_to_access: Walk-ins welcome; serves the west side, open Tuesdays and Thursdays 10 AM–1 PM.

options.name: Paratransit Info Desk (fictional)
options.how_to_access: Apply for ADA paratransit certification by phone; decisions may take up to 21 days, so this is better for ongoing needs than urgent appointments.
